import Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.Degree
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Eval
import Mathlib.Order.ConditionallyCompleteLattice.Finset
import Mathlib.Basic.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Weight
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPowerSeries.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.Tactic
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.RingDivision
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
#check_failure Roth.degreeOf_coeffNone_le
open MvPolynomial
namespace CoefficientDegree157
variable {τ R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
#check @MvPolynomial.degreeOf_le_iff
#check @MvPolynomial.monomial_le_degreeOf
#check @MvPolynomial.mem_support_coeff_optionEquivLeft
#check @MvPolynomial.degreeOf_coeff_finSuccEquiv
#check @MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft_coeff_coeff
theorem canonical (P : MvPolynomial (Option τ) R) (ν : ℕ) (j : τ) :
    degreeOf j ((optionEquivLeft R τ P).coeff ν) ≤ degreeOf (some j) P := by
  refine degreeOf_le_iff.2 fun d hd ↦ ?_
  simpa using monomial_le_degreeOf (some j) ((mem_support_coeff_optionEquivLeft R).1 hd)
theorem support_bound {α β : Type*}
    (s : Finset α) (t : Finset β) (f : α → β) (a : α → ℕ) (b : β → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ s, f x ∈ t) (hab : ∀ x ∈ s, a x ≤ b (f x)) :
    s.sup a ≤ t.sup b := by
  exact Finset.sup_le fun x hx ↦ (hab x hx).trans (Finset.le_sup (h x hx))
theorem strict_guard :
    degreeOf () ((optionEquivLeft ℕ Unit
      (X (some ()) : MvPolynomial (Option Unit) ℕ)).coeff 1) <
      degreeOf (some ()) (X (some ()) : MvPolynomial (Option Unit) ℕ) := by
  simp
#print axioms canonical
#print axioms support_bound
#print axioms strict_guard
end CoefficientDegree157

@degreeOf_le_iff : ∀ {R : Type u_3} {σ : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] {n : σ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : ℕ},
  degreeOf n f ≤ d ↔ ∀ m ∈ f.support, m n ≤ d

@monomial_le_degreeOf : ∀ {R : Type u_3} {σ : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] (i : σ) {f : MvPolynomial σ R}
  {m : σ →₀ ℕ}, m ∈ f.support → m i ≤ degreeOf i f

mem_support_coeff_optionEquivLeft : ∀ (R : Type u_3) {σ : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R]
  {f : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R} {i : ℕ} {m : σ →₀ ℕ},
  m ∈ (((optionEquivLeft R σ) f).coeff i).support ↔ Finsupp.optionElim i m ∈ f.support

@degreeOf_coeff_finSuccEquiv : ∀ {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] {n : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R)
  (j : Fin n) (i : ℕ), degreeOf j (((MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv R n) p).coeff i) ≤ degreeOf j.succ p

optionEquivLeft_coeff_coeff : ∀ (R : Type u_3) {σ : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R)
  (m : ℕ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (((optionEquivLeft R σ) p).coeff m).coeff d = p.coeff (Finsupp.optionElim m d)
